segments.text: Ok so this is the WebMCP page for OpenAI Agents with Vue, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, umm, the handler calls searchOrders, but that function is never defined or imported.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
The provider and the chat weren't on this page, so I added them from the quickstart.
Moving on to the demo. I asked the agent to search my open orders, it should run the tool and answer, but uh, no reply comes back at all.
So basically, the tool handler throws because searchOrders doesn't exist, and the run just dies without any message.
